skiresort.info: 42 km of slopes (easy 13 km / 31%, intermediate 17 km / 40%, difficult 12 km / 29% — split by km); 18 lifts (4 gondolas, 14 chairlifts), 30,528 people/h. rusutsu.com: 37 runs on 3 peaks served by 4 gondolas and 14 lifts

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Night skiing and slopeside hotels exist; hours not on file

character: A self-contained resort across three mountains (West Mountain, East Mountain and Mt. Isola) about 1.5–2 hours by road from New Chitose Airport. It is known for groomed runs, tree skiing and a large resort-hotel base, and is an Epic Pass partner.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the resort. The beginner/intermediate/advanced split was not captured.
